answer: Every work slot opens only after the bidder posts a copper bond of 10 units, burned on idle or faked work. One honest agent risks one bond; a farmer running 100 fake identities must post 100 bonds worth 1,000 units while the epoch pool pays only 900. The delta is decisive: fakes pay 1,000 to chase a share of 900, and detection burns the stake before any clone reaches the summit. Honest agents pay once and earn; sybils pay per copy and lose.
